sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A circumboreal moss of cool, moist forests, tundra and alpine habitats. It forms mats on soil, humus, dead wood and sometimes rocks; stems reach about 20 cm.

sections.title: Branches and sporophytes
sections.text: The branches form flattened annual tiers, often 2–5 cm wide. Like other mosses, it produces neither flowers nor fruit; capsules on setae may appear.
